Based on the code in `merge_sorted_lists_03.py`:

1.  **`out = [0] * (len(left) + len(right))`** establishes a pre-allocated list of the correct total size (the sum of the lengths of the two input lists) filled with placeholder zeros. This ensures the list has the exact capacity needed for the merged result before any elements are moved.

2.  **How the merge fills the allocated list:**
    The merge uses two pointers (one for each input list) to iterate through the lists. It compares the elements at the current positions and places the smaller element into the next available position in the `out` list. This process continues until all elements from both input lists have been placed into the allocated list.
